author: FrozenThorn
body:
Hey everyone, 

I am back onto the forums! Sorry for being gone so long, for some reason my account wouldn't let me log onto here so I have managed to create a new account so that I can frequently visit the forums and catch up with everyone! How is everyone doing? I hope you are all okay :). 

I can't wait until I can start to properly get involved in the forums again, after being gone so long, I hope I can be welcomed back okay!
